Outlook Looking ahead, the near-term outlook remains cautiously optimistic subject to resolution of the geo- political conflict.
While macroeconomic challenges are expected to persist in the short term especially on account of Iran and US/Israel War, pressures on costs may persists.
Accordingly, in the near-term outlook requires agility and prudence.
Looking ahead, the near-term outlook requires agility and prudence.
Government austerity measures and fuel conservation efforts have further clouded near-term demand outlook.
Future Outlook / Growth Strategy The near-term outlook for the home appliances sector remains cautious amid ongoing geopolitical uncertainties and elevated inflation.

However, the structural drivers like rising urbanization, a young population, improving household asset ownership, and government focus on local manufacturing and electronics policy will continue to support medium to long-term growth potential.
